name: fscan-corroborated-udp-probe-evidence
instr:
fscan cannot corroborate UDP findings across repeated, protocol-correlated exchanges. Add configurable attempt and minimum-match counts to CLI and embedded scans, defaulting each to one. Before scanning, reject invalid policies with `ErrInvalidUDPProbePolicy` from `github.com/shadow1ng/fscan/common` and text `invalid UDP probe policy`.

Sessions from `NewScanSession` must record admitted attempts in request order. Charge packet allowance once per attempt, including transport failures. Stop when confidence succeeds or becomes impossible, attempts run out, or context is cancelled. Do not create later observations. Rejected replies are observations, not sends or findings.

Keep matchers registered through `WithUDPResponseMatcher` protocol-specific. Export `UDPResponseMatch`, `UDPResponseMatcher`, and `UDPPluginOption` from `github.com/shadow1ng/fscan/plugins/services`. Keep variadic `RegisterUDPPluginWithPorts` compatible with three-argument registrations.

For BACnet, DNS, IPMI, SNMP, and TFTP, count only structurally valid responses correlated with the current request. Correlate BACnet I-Am with Who-Is, DNS by query identifier, valid IPMI RMCP responses, and SNMP by request and community. Keep equivalent device fingerprints stable. Preserve SNMP community-probing cancellation and early stopping. Classify IPMI vulnerabilities only after confidence.
